regime_read: Convergence favors AI compute and semiconductor infrastructure: NVDA has the broadest independent alignment, while MU and INTC add upstream memory and domestic-capacity signals. With no scored track record yet, conviction remains medium at best, and sentiment-heavy clusters are excluded.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号集中指向AI算力与半导体基础设施：NVDA的独立渠道共振最广，MU与INTC则分别提供上游存储和本土产能信号。由于尚无已评分战绩，最高置信度仅为中等，并剔除主要由情绪驱动的信号簇。

theses.thesis: The pack's strongest convergence combines smart-money additions, threshold-defined dark-pool accumulation, developer adoption, patent activity and near-unanimous analyst support [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. Disclosed holdings by Pelosi, Greene and McCaul add a separate influence-graph signal, although congressional ownership is not proof of fresh buying [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The stock is not extended versus SPY, so the entry has not been disqualified.
theses.thesis_zh: 证据包中最强的共振来自聪明资金增持、达到阈值的暗池吸筹、开发者采用、专利活动及近乎一致的分析师看多 [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。Pelosi、Greene和McCaul的已披露持仓构成独立的影响力图信号，但国会议员持仓并不等同于近期新增买入 [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。相对SPY并未处于过度延伸状态，因此入场条件尚未失效。
second_order: MU — AI accelerators increase demand for high-bandwidth memory and related memory capacity.
MSFT — cloud and AI application demand can monetize expanded accelerator availability.
Data-center power and cooling — greater accelerator deployment raises infrastructure intensity.
theses.dissent: Retail buzz and an earnings report in 13 days can make the signal crowded and expose the shares to a sharp expectations reset [retail_buzz] [special_situation].

falsifier.text: Dark-pool accumulation reverses and developer momentum weakens after the upcoming earnings report.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MU shows alignment across insider buying, analyst upgrades, patents and unusually strong government-grant acceleration, supported by uniformly bullish sampled social sentiment [insider_mspr] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster] [gov_grant_accel] [stocktwits_bull]. The signals span capital, policy support and technology rather than relying on one channel. Relative strength is positive but remains below the pack's extended threshold.
theses.thesis_zh: MU在内部人买入、分析师上调、专利活动及显著的政府补助加速方面形成共振，同时样本内社交情绪一致看多 [insider_mspr] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [patent_cluster] [gov_grant_accel] [stocktwits_bull]。这些信号横跨资本、政策支持和技术渠道，并非依赖单一指标。其相对强势为正，但仍低于证据包所设的过度延伸阈值。
second_order: NVDA — greater memory supply supports shipment of memory-intensive AI accelerators.
Data-center memory suppliers — sustained AI workloads lift demand across the memory stack.
Semiconductor equipment — capacity additions imply downstream fabrication-tool demand.
theses.dissent: The stock has already outperformed SPY materially, while bullish analyst and social readings may reflect expectations that are partly embedded.

falsifier.text: Government-grant momentum stalls and insider buying is not followed by improving memory demand.

theses.thesis: INTC combines dark-pool accumulation, government support, the pack's largest patent count among the semiconductor names and unanimous sampled analyst bullishness [darkpool_accum] [gov_grant] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. Its substantial underperformance versus SPY leaves room for a contrarian rerating if domestic semiconductor investment translates into execution, but the absence of an actor signal and only modest grant acceleration keep conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: INTC同时出现暗池吸筹、政府支持、证据包半导体公司中最高的专利数量以及样本内分析师一致看多 [darkpool_accum] [gov_grant] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。其相对SPY明显落后，若美国本土半导体投资转化为经营执行，存在逆向重估空间；但缺少重要人物信号且补助加速度有限，因此置信度较低。
second_order: Domestic semiconductor equipment — successful capacity build-out requires fabrication tools.
U.S. chip packaging and materials — reshoring expands demand beyond wafer fabrication.
Enterprise PC and server supply chains — execution improvement could stabilize component demand.
theses.dissent: Persistent relative weakness may be correctly signaling execution and competitive problems that patents, grants and sentiment cannot resolve.

falsifier.text: Dark-pool accumulation disappears while government-supported capacity fails to produce measurable operating progress.

theses.thesis: MSFT's convergence links end-user app demand with developer momentum, patents and policy engagement [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [lobbying]. The factual partnership with Sam Altman supplies an influence-graph bridge between AI infrastructure and distribution [actor:Sam Altman]. This is a coherent platform-demand signal, but without direct capital-flow accumulation in the pack it remains low conviction.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的共振将终端应用需求、开发者动能、专利活动与政策参与连接起来 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [lobbying]。与Sam Altman的事实性合作关系在AI基础设施和分发渠道之间形成影响力图桥梁 [actor:Sam Altman]。该平台需求逻辑较为连贯，但证据包中缺少直接资金流吸筹信号，因此置信度较低。
second_order: NVDA — cloud AI usage supports demand for accelerator capacity.
Enterprise software ecosystem — developer momentum can expand AI-enabled application adoption.
Data-center power infrastructure — cloud compute growth increases electricity and cooling requirements.
theses.dissent: Strong app and developer metrics may describe an established franchise rather than an incremental acceleration, and the pack shows no dark-pool or 13F confirmation.

falsifier.text: App demand and developer momentum weaken without corresponding growth in AI platform adoption.

track_record.calibration_note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.
